data.body:
Root cause proven by controlled probe before any code change. Probe advanced a test execution row from TASK_RECEIVED to IMPLEMENTING via persist_execution_state and observed a byte identical updated_at, confirming the onupdate default does not fire for the on_conflict_do_update set_ mapping. Two competing hypotheses were refuted first. An empty EXECUTION_ORPHAN_GRACE_SECONDS in .env resolves to 120, not 0. The updated_at values are timezone aware UTC and produce clean deltas.

Production evidence: execution intake-ee0f760a reached PR_CREATED at 02:40:46 and was marked CANCELLED at 02:41:19, 33 seconds later against a 120 second grace, because its frozen updated_at was 39 minutes old. That freed the intake active guard and admitted duplicate run intake-8383b6ac for the same ticket.

Each acceptance criterion selector was run on its own and passed. Reverting each fix independently was checked to fail the matching tests, so none of them pass vacuously. Full inv ci is green with 1457 passed, 6 skipped, and eval-gate PASS.

The fix deliberately does not add PR_CREATED to a global terminal state list. services/orchestration/webhook/pr_events.py selects non-terminal executions to resolve which run to signal when a pull request closes, so PR_CREATED has to stay non-terminal there.
